title: 06-febe-rhino-transform-orient-workflows
summary: Added the typed reference-point Move/Copy, Rotate and Scale 1D/2D/3D command sessions plus SetPt/align services, and fixed the three-point orientation frame composition (transpose order). Added 8 core tests, 3 kernel transform tests and 17 app gumball checks; the existing transform math is covered too.

gaps_found: No typed reference-point Move/Copy/Rotate/Scale command session.
Three-point orientation composed the frame in the transposed order; translation-only tests did not catch it.
audit_result.gaps_closed: Added crates/om9-core/src/transform_session.rs, fixed transform_ops::orient_three_point, added focused tests and 31 L4 receipts, updated L1/L2/L3 runtime and the ledger.

remaining: All six M03-UI reference-picker/preview/commit/cancel workflows are unsigned.
